description: Carlos Quesada-Granja publishes processed GoiEner electricity measurements as 28,900 individual profiles and 145,194 annual series. Version 7.1, released in September 2026 under CC BY 4.0, is freely downloadable as compressed CSV files. Individual profiles retain available consumption, generation, import/export and reactive-energy variables before later gap filling. The annual matrix contains 8,904 hourly positions per series, with missing timestamps imputed and daylight-saving transitions regularised. Profiles use end-of-interval timestamps; annual values shift to the start of the measured hour. These representations can support load-shape and demand-simulation comparisons. Public metadata retain only identifiers and two-digit economic-activity codes, with geography and contracted power excluded. Exact observation years are not stated in the README. Related catalogue record data-goiener-smart-meter-data-spain covers the earlier source collection, not this documented transformation. Imputation uncertainty and file integrity were not independently tested.
